intended_input: BCI-like HER2 IHC tiles, 1024 px, about 0.46 um/px
warnings: Research software. Not clinically validated. Do not use for diagnosis or treatment decisions.
Scores individual tiles only. There is no slide-level or patient-level score.
Performance applies to BCI-like tiles only. On HER2-IHC-40x this model scored 0.435 accuracy and very low 1+ and 2+ recall.
Do not apply stain calibration to this model: it collapses.
